buttonList.text:
After exiting you can load and use it again via "Smart Touch".

Loading "Classic Touch" will exit "Lock-key Touch" and enable it directly without going through "Smart Touch".

This step is used to turn off the current touch or function.

If it cannot be turned off, please follow these steps: "Focus Notifications -- Settings"
to close the conflicting touch or function.
Continue the "initialization process" for further setup?

Selecting "Continue" will continue the initialization process and let you choose touch controls.
New users are advised to continue and try things out via the guided tour.

Selecting "Skip" will enable "Classic Touch" and skip the following steps.

Whether you continue or not means you agree to the "Terms of Use".
